visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black cap worn backward and a pink T-shirt sits in the driver's seat of a modern car. He is speaking directly to someone off-camera, gesturing with his right hand. The car's interior is dark, and bright sunlight enters through the open sunroof and side window, showing a bustling urban street background. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a shop named 'the slice shop'. A white square sign with a cartoon pizza slice and red text is prominent. Through the large glass window, several trays of different large pizzas are visible on metal racks inside a clean, modern display. (3) Back inside the car, the man holds a large yellow cardboard pizza box that fills most of the frame. He opens the lid to reveal six distinct slices of pizza with various toppings like pepperoni, meat, and pineapple. He points enthusiastically at the different flavors with his index finger. (4) The man picks up a small, rectangular transparent bottle containing yellow liquid (oil). He unscrews the red cap and carefully drips the liquid onto a slice of pizza topped with meat and peppers. He then picks up a large pepperoni slice, demonstrates its flexibility by bending the crust, and rolls it tightly into a cylinder before taking a large bite. (5) A final shot shows the exterior of 'the slice shop' again, surrounded by potted plants and a narrow city street with parked motorcycles and passing vehicles under a clear sky.
